cells.forex: Exchange rates between two currencies, quoted as a [[currency-pair]].
cells.stocks: [[share|Shares]] in companies, usually listed on a stock exchange.
cells.penny_stocks: Shares in very small companies with a low price per share, often thinly traded, sometimes outside the main exchanges.
cells.commodities: Raw materials such as metals, energy and farm goods, reached through futures, broker contracts or funds.
cells.futures: Standardised contracts on an underlying such as an index, a currency, a rate or a [[commodity]], each with its own specification.

caveat: What exactly you can trade depends on the broker, the exchange and where you live. The same market name can cover very different products.
